children: Inflection Point Fund I, LP disclosed a 9.87% beneficial stake in GOWell Energy Technology. The filing, dated Oct. 02, 2026, follows the company’s business combination completed on Sept. 24–25, 2026. The position includes ordinary shares plus shares issuable from preferred stock and warrants tied to a prior $20 million investment.

Inflection Point Fund I says it holds the stake for investment and may engage with GOWell Energy Technology’s management and other shareholders. The fund may “work with management and the board to identify, evaluate, structure, negotiate, execute or otherwise facilitate a business combination” and support efforts to raise capital.

The fund may buy or sell shares, use hedging, or engage in short sales and swaps. A registration rights agreement also allows it to register and resell its securities, giving the investor flexibility in how it manages the position.

Inflection Point Fund I, LP is a Delaware limited partnership whose principal business is to invest in and hold securities. The fund participated in the SPAC transaction that combined Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V with GOWell, and it invested $20 million into GOWell in Series A preferred shares and warrants. Its investment committee includes Michael Blitzer and Kevin Shannon, who have prior ties to the SPAC and now help oversee voting and disposition decisions.
